description: This is the MainActivity.java source file for an Android application implementing sliding tabs. It sets up the main activity, handles menu options for toggling the log display, and initializes logging components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the sliding tabs Android app, responsible for UI setup, menu handling, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the SlidingTabsBasicFragment if first created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for the activity.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, showing or hiding log toggle based on the view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, toggling the log view when toggle is selected.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain to output logs to the LogFragment and also to the LogWrapper.
